definition: a narrow way for walking, or the direction something moves in
sentence: A {path} leads from the gate to the front door.
translation: От калитки к входной двери ведёт дорожка.

definition: to change a text or film to make it better or shorter

translation: Мне нужно отредактировать эссе, прежде чем сдавать.

definition: a large road vehicle for carrying heavy goods

translation: Грузовик привёз новую мебель.

definition: to say that someone is responsible for something bad

translation: Не вини меня за разбитое окно.

definition: likely to cause harm or injury

translation: Здесь опасно плавать, когда море неспокойно.

definition: very; to a very great degree

translation: Экзамен был чрезвычайно трудным для всех.

definition: used to make a statement stronger, or to show agreement

translation: День и в самом деле был очень холодным.

definition: a series of events that happen again and again in the same order

translation: Цикл времён года никогда не меняется.

definition: to finish your studies at a university or school and get a degree

translation: Следующим летом она окончит университет.

definition: loved very much, or used at the start of a letter

translation: Она мой очень дорогой друг.

definition: to raise something to a higher position

definition: coming after four others in order

translation: Это её пятый визит в Японию.

definition: to move people or goods from one place to another in a vehicle

translation: Грузовики перевозят фрукты с ферм в город.

definition: the way a person or thing looks, or the act of arriving somewhere

translation: Её внешность сильно изменилась после болезни.

definition: a drink with alcohol that is made from grapes

translation: Мы выпили бутылку красного вина за ужином.

definition: a deep round dish for food or liquid
sentence: She ate a {bowl} of soup for lunch.
translation: На обед она съела миску супа.

definition: not common; not happening often
sentence: Snow is {rare} in this part of the country.
translation: Снег в этой части страны — редкость.

definition: pleased about something you or people close to you have done
sentence: Her parents were very {proud} when she passed the exam.
translation: Родители очень гордились ею, когда она сдала экзамен.

definition: a person who buys goods or services

translation: Новый закон защищает каждого потребителя от несправедливых цен.

definition: to hit something hard, causing damage, or to fail suddenly

translation: Машина на полной скорости врезалась в стену.

definition: the day each year when you celebrate the day you were born

translation: В прошлую субботу у нас была вечеринка в честь моего дня рождения.

definition: to decide or end something, or to start living in a place
sentence: They decided to {settle} in a small town by the sea.
translation: Они решили поселиться в маленьком городке у моря.

definition: to officially agree to something, or to think it is good
sentence: The council will {approve} the plan for the new park.
translation: Совет одобрит план нового парка.

definition: the act of winning a game, battle or election
sentence: The team celebrated their {victory} all night.
translation: Команда праздновала победу всю ночь.

definition: hard physical work, or all the workers of a country
sentence: The farm needs a lot of {labor} at harvest time.
translation: Ферме нужно много рабочих рук во время сбора урожая.

definition: a round object with a hard shell laid by a bird, often eaten as food
sentence: I had a boiled {egg} for breakfast.
translation: На завтрак я съел варёное яйцо.

definition: of high quality and known for a long time, or typical
sentence: The film is a {classic} that everyone should see.
translation: Этот фильм — классика, которую должен увидеть каждый.

definition: to say or do something again
sentence: Could you {repeat} the question, please?
translation: Не могли бы вы повторить вопрос?

definition: the time when a person is young, or young people in general
sentence: In his {youth} he played football every day.
translation: В юности он каждый день играл в футбол.

definition: the unit of money of the United Kingdom, or a unit of weight
sentence: The ticket costs ten pounds, so one {pound} will not help.
translation: Билет стоит десять фунтов, так что один фунт не поможет.

definition: separated by a distance of space or time
sentence: The two houses are only a few meters {apart}.
translation: Два дома стоят всего в нескольких метрах друг от друга.

definition: knowing that something exists or is happening
sentence: Are you {aware} that the shop closes at five?
translation: Ты в курсе, что магазин закрывается в пять?

definition: in or from the east
sentence: The {eastern} part of the city is older and quieter.
translation: Восточная часть города старше и тише.

definition: used when the woman or girl who does the action also receives it
sentence: She hurt {herself} when she fell off the bike.
translation: Она ушиблась, когда упала с велосипеда.

definition: not able to happen or be done
sentence: It is {impossible} to finish this work in one day.
translation: Невозможно закончить эту работу за один день.

definition: the work of advertising and selling a company's products
sentence: She works in {marketing} for a big food company.
translation: Она работает в маркетинге крупной пищевой компании.

definition: used after "neither" or "not" to add another negative
sentence: I have neither the time {nor} the money for a holiday.
translation: У меня нет ни времени, ни денег на отпуск.

definition: to make someone remember something
sentence: Please {remind} me to call my mother tonight.
translation: Пожалуйста, напомни мне позвонить маме сегодня вечером.

definition: to cover a wall with color, or to make a picture with a brush
sentence: We will {paint} the bedroom blue this weekend.
translation: В эти выходные мы покрасим спальню в синий.

definition: to become larger, or to make something larger
sentence: The company plans to {expand} into three new countries.
translation: Компания планирует расширить бизнес в три новые страны.

definition: a border of wood or metal around a picture, door or window
sentence: The photo is in a silver {frame} on the shelf.
translation: Фотография в серебряной рамке стоит на полке.

definition: a line of metal rings joined together, or shops owned by one company
sentence: The dog was tied to the gate with a {chain}.
translation: Собака была привязана к воротам цепью.

definition: concerts, plays or films held every year, or a special day of celebration
sentence: The music {festival} takes place every August.
translation: Музыкальный фестиваль проходит каждый август.

definition: having good things happen to you by chance
sentence: You are {lucky} to have such a good friend.
translation: Тебе повезло иметь такого хорошего друга.

definition: the person in charge of a state or region
sentence: The {governor} visited the town after the flood.
translation: Губернатор посетил город после наводнения.

definition: having a lot to do, or full of people or activity
sentence: I am too {busy} to go out this evening.
translation: Я слишком занят, чтобы выйти сегодня вечером.

definition: a narrow line of light or heat
sentence: A {ray} of sunlight came through the curtains.
translation: Луч солнца пробился сквозь шторы.

definition: a substance taken to treat an illness, or the science of treating illness
sentence: Take the {medicine} three times a day with water.
translation: Принимай лекарство три раза в день, запивая водой.

definition: a piece of clothing with sleeves and buttons worn on the upper body
sentence: He wore a white {shirt} and a blue tie.
translation: На нём были белая рубашка и синий галстук.

definition: a lawyer, especially in the United States
sentence: The {attorney} advised him not to say anything.
translation: Адвокат посоветовал ему ничего не говорить.

definition: willing to accept different ideas and behavior, or supporting social change
sentence: Her parents have {liberal} views and let her choose her own path.
translation: У её родителей либеральные взгляды, и они позволяют ей самой выбирать путь.

definition: a strong hard metal, or a device for making clothes smooth
sentence: The old bridge is made of {iron}.
translation: Старый мост сделан из железа.

definition: to send back light or an image, or to think carefully about something
sentence: Mirrors {reflect} light into the dark corners of the room.
translation: Зеркала отражают свет в тёмные углы комнаты.

definition: a large round object in space that moves around a star
sentence: Mars is the fourth {planet} from the sun.
translation: Марс — четвёртая планета от Солнца.

definition: the act of going into a place, or something written in a diary or list
sentence: {Entry} to the museum is free on Sundays.
translation: Вход в музей по воскресеньям бесплатный.

definition: a building where interesting or valuable objects are kept and shown to the public
sentence: The {museum} has a collection of old coins.
translation: В музее есть коллекция старинных монет.

definition: houses and flats for people to live in
sentence: The city needs more cheap {housing} for young families.
translation: Городу нужно больше дешёвого жилья для молодых семей.

definition: the position of being a leader, or the ability to lead
sentence: The team needs strong {leadership} to win.
translation: Команде нужно сильное руководство, чтобы победить.

definition: not one and not the other of two
sentence: {Neither} answer on the test is correct.
translation: Ни один из ответов в тесте не верен.

definition: used to show movement to a position on a surface
sentence: The cat jumped {onto} the table.
translation: Кошка запрыгнула на стол.

definition: perhaps; maybe
sentence: It will {possibly} rain this afternoon.
translation: Возможно, сегодня днём пойдёт дождь.

definition: the programs that make a computer work
sentence: You need to update the {software} on your phone.
translation: Тебе нужно обновить программы на телефоне.

definition: a warning or a danger that something bad will happen
sentence: Rain is the main {threat} to our picnic plans.
translation: Дождь — главная угроза нашим планам на пикник.

definition: money that you owe to someone
sentence: He paid off his {debt} to the bank last year.
translation: В прошлом году он выплатил долг банку.

definition: the quality of being very pleasant to look at
sentence: The {beauty} of the mountains took our breath away.
translation: Красота гор захватила дух.

definition: to say something officially or publicly
sentence: The judge will {declare} the winner at six o'clock.
translation: Судья объявит победителя в шесть часов.

definition: smooth and level, without hills or bumps
sentence: The road is {flat} for the next ten miles.
translation: Дорога ровная на следующие десять миль.

definition: a small amount of something that shows what the whole is like
sentence: The doctor took a blood {sample} for testing.
translation: Врач взял образец крови на анализ.

definition: a room where an artist works, or where films, music or programs are made
sentence: The band recorded the song in a small {studio}.
translation: Группа записала песню в маленькой студии.

definition: to climb onto a horse or bicycle, or to fix something in position
sentence: She helped the child {mount} the pony.
translation: Она помогла ребёнку сесть на пони.

definition: the work of a teacher, or the ideas a person or religion teaches
sentence: She went into {teaching} after ten years as an engineer.
translation: После десяти лет работы инженером она стала преподавать.

definition: a weapon that explodes and causes great damage
sentence: The {bomb} destroyed half the street.
translation: Бомба разрушила половину улицы.

definition: a drink with alcohol that is made from grain and has bubbles
sentence: He ordered a glass of cold {beer}.
translation: Он заказал бокал холодного пива.

definition: to make someone feel very happy and interested
sentence: The idea of a trip to Paris seemed to {excite} the children.
translation: Мысль о поездке в Париж, похоже, взбудоражила детей.

definition: honest and direct, even when it is not pleasant
sentence: I'll be {frank}: I didn't like the food.
translation: Буду честен: еда мне не понравилась.

definition: the grey or black gas that rises from something burning
sentence: Thick {smoke} came out of the chimney.
translation: Из трубы валил густой дым.

definition: to usually do something or be likely to happen
sentence: Children {tend} to wake up early on holidays.
translation: Дети, как правило, рано просыпаются в праздники.

definition: to make a person or animal feel afraid
sentence: Loud noises always {scare} our little dog.
translation: Громкие звуки всегда пугают нашу собачку.

definition: shared by or belonging to two or more people
sentence: The couple opened a {joint} bank account.
translation: Пара открыла совместный банковский счёт.

definition: the people who work on a ship, plane or train
sentence: The {crew} of the ship came from five countries.
translation: Экипаж корабля был из пяти стран.

definition: very bad weather with strong wind and heavy rain
sentence: The {storm} blew down trees across the city.
translation: Буря повалила деревья по всему городу.

definition: the part of a plant that grows under the ground, or the cause of something
sentence: The tree's {root} broke through the garden wall.
translation: Корень дерева пробил садовую стену.

definition: a part of the sea that curves into the land
sentence: The boats were safe in the {bay} during the storm.
translation: Лодки были в безопасности в бухте во время бури.

definition: large sheets of printed paper with news, sold every day or week
sentence: My father reads the {newspaper} every morning.
translation: Мой отец читает газету каждое утро.

definition: a group of people or things with similar qualities
sentence: Books are arranged by {category}: history, science and art.
translation: Книги расставлены по категориям: история, наука и искусство.

definition: a screen that shows information from a computer
sentence: I bought a bigger {monitor} for my computer.
translation: Я купил монитор побольше для своего компьютера.

definition: living; not dead
sentence: The old man is still {alive} at ninety-five.
translation: Старик в девяносто пять всё ещё жив.

definition: the power to make impossible things happen, as in stories, or tricks done for fun
sentence: The children believed the wizard used real {magic}.
translation: Дети верили, что волшебник использует настоящую магию.

definition: the management of money, especially by governments and companies
sentence: She works in {finance} for an international bank.
translation: Она работает в финансах в международном банке.

definition: a part of a tree growing out from the trunk, or a local office
sentence: A bird sat on the {branch} outside my window.
translation: Птица сидела на ветке за моим окном.

definition: a part of a country's economy, or an area
sentence: Many people work in the service {sector}.
translation: Многие люди работают в сфере услуг.

definition: a general direction in which something is changing or developing
sentence: Working from cafes is a big {trend} in our city.
translation: Работать из кафе — большой тренд в нашем городе.

definition: the son of a king or queen
sentence: The {prince} will become king when his father dies.
translation: Принц станет королём, когда умрёт его отец.

definition: not strong in body or character, or not powerful
sentence: She felt {weak} after a week in bed with flu.
translation: После недели в постели с гриппом она чувствовала слабость.

definition: one part or feature of a situation or idea
sentence: Money is only one {aspect} of the problem.
translation: Деньги — лишь одна сторона проблемы.

definition: a person who helps someone in their work
sentence: The doctor's {assistant} booked my next visit.
translation: Помощница врача записала меня на следующий приём.

definition: one of the parts into which a book is divided
sentence: I read the first {chapter} of the novel last night.
translation: Вчера вечером я прочитал первую главу романа.

sentence: This is only a {draft}; the final letter will be longer.
translation: Это только черновик, окончательное письмо будет длиннее.

definition: something very bad or morally wrong
sentence: The film is about the fight between good and {evil}.
translation: Фильм о борьбе добра и зла.

definition: a glass or plastic container with a narrow neck for liquids
sentence: She drank a {bottle} of water after the run.
translation: После пробежки она выпила бутылку воды.

definition: the central or most important part of something
sentence: Honesty is at the {core} of their friendship.
translation: Честность — основа их дружбы.

definition: to pass an exam or reach a standard needed for a job or competition
sentence: She hopes to {qualify} as a nurse next year.
translation: Она надеется получить квалификацию медсестры в следующем году.

definition: to clean something with water
sentence: {Wash} your hands before you eat.
translation: Мой руки перед едой.

definition: a low area of land between hills or mountains, often with a river
sentence: A river runs through the middle of the {valley}.
translation: Через середину долины протекает река.

definition: to win against someone in a game, battle or election
sentence: Our team managed to {defeat} the champions.
translation: Наша команда сумела победить чемпионов.

definition: the way a person or animal acts
sentence: The teacher praised the children for their good {behavior}.
translation: Учительница похвалила детей за хорошее поведение.

definition: the system of connected pages on the internet, or a net made by a spider
sentence: You can read the newspaper on the {web} for free.
translation: Газету можно бесплатно читать в интернете.

definition: to choose someone for a position by voting
sentence: The town will {elect} a new mayor next month.
translation: В следующем месяце город выберет нового мэра.

definition: a large container for liquid or gas, or a heavy military vehicle
sentence: The car has a full {tank} of petrol.
translation: У машины полный бак бензина.

definition: the group of people elected to make a country's laws
sentence: {Parliament} voted on the new law yesterday.
translation: Парламент вчера проголосовал за новый закон.

definition: relating to the art, music, beliefs and customs of a group of people
sentence: The city is famous for its {cultural} life.
translation: Город известен своей культурной жизнью.

definition: a little, by a small amount
sentence: The soup is {slightly} too salty for me.
translation: Суп для меня немного пересолен.

definition: relating to machines, science or a particular skill
sentence: The flight was delayed because of a {technical} problem.
translation: Рейс задержали из-за технической неисправности.

definition: being the only one of its kind
sentence: Every person has a {unique} fingerprint.
translation: У каждого человека уникальные отпечатки пальцев.

definition: behavior that hurts or kills people
sentence: There was no {violence} at the protest.
translation: На протесте не было насилия.

definition: belonging to you
sentence: Is this coat {yours} or mine?
translation: Это пальто твоё или моё?

definition: a piece of paper or cloth fixed to something that gives information about it
sentence: Read the {label} on the bottle before you take the medicine.
translation: Прочитай этикетку на бутылке, прежде чем принимать лекарство.

definition: to take hold of something suddenly and roughly
sentence: The thief tried to {grab} her bag and run.
translation: Вор попытался выхватить её сумку и убежать.

definition: a sudden serious situation that needs immediate action
sentence: Call this number only in an {emergency}.
translation: Звоните по этому номеру только в экстренном случае.

definition: to think that something is true or that someone has done something wrong
sentence: I {suspect} that he is not telling the truth.
translation: Подозреваю, что он говорит неправду.

definition: a large structure filled with water for swimming
sentence: The hotel has a {pool} on the roof.
translation: В отеле есть бассейн на крыше.

definition: one of the very large areas of salt water that cover the Earth
sentence: We swam in the {ocean} every morning.
translation: Мы каждое утро купались в океане.

definition: hard and firm, not liquid or gas
sentence: The lake was frozen {solid} in January.
translation: В январе озеро промёрзло насквозь.

definition: to help someone
sentence: A nurse will {assist} the doctor during the operation.
translation: Медсестра будет помогать врачу во время операции.

definition: to take another person's child into your family legally, or to start using something
sentence: They decided to {adopt} a baby from abroad.
translation: Они решили усыновить ребёнка из-за границы.

definition: a state in which things are dirty or not in order
sentence: Your room is a {mess}; please clean it.
translation: В твоей комнате бардак, пожалуйста, убери.

definition: a picture made with paint, or the activity of making one
sentence: A large {painting} of the sea hangs above the fireplace.
translation: Большая картина с морем висит над камином.

definition: very angry, or mentally ill
sentence: My mother was {mad} when I came home late.
translation: Мама была в ярости, когда я пришёл домой поздно.

definition: an official rule
sentence: There is a {regulation} against smoking in the park.
translation: Есть правило, запрещающее курить в парке.

definition: very beautiful or very pleasant
sentence: What a {lovely} garden you have!
translation: Какой у вас прекрасный сад!

definition: people in general, or people of a particular type
sentence: Country {folk} go to bed early.
translation: Деревенские жители ложатся спать рано.

definition: to promise that something will happen or is true
sentence: We {guarantee} that the parcel will arrive by Friday.
translation: Мы гарантируем, что посылка прибудет к пятнице.

definition: happening at the beginning
sentence: My {initial} reaction was to say no.
translation: Моей первой реакцией было сказать нет.

definition: a long written story about imaginary people
sentence: She is reading a {novel} about life in Paris.
translation: Она читает роман о жизни в Париже.

definition: a hot drink made by pouring boiling water on dried leaves
sentence: Would you like a cup of {tea}?
translation: Хотите чашку чая?

definition: the money a company or government receives
sentence: The company's {revenue} grew by ten percent last year.
translation: Доход компании вырос на десять процентов в прошлом году.

definition: for all time; always
sentence: I will remember this day {forever}.
translation: Я буду помнить этот день всегда.

definition: in or to a place that is not known or named
sentence: I left my keys {somewhere} in the kitchen.
translation: Я где-то оставил ключи на кухне.

definition: a set of rooms for living in, on one floor of a building
sentence: They rent a small {apartment} near the station.
translation: Они снимают маленькую квартиру рядом с вокзалом.

definition: a flat round dish that food is served on
sentence: Put the sandwiches on a {plate}.
translation: Положи сэндвичи на тарелку.

definition: not liking change, or preferring traditional ways
sentence: My grandfather has {conservative} views about marriage.
translation: У моего дедушки консервативные взгляды на брак.

definition: the remaining parts of a building that has fallen down, or complete loss
sentence: We visited the {ruin} of an old castle on the hill.
translation: Мы посетили руины старого замка на холме.

definition: the part of the day between midday and the evening
sentence: We went for a walk in the {afternoon}.
translation: Днём мы пошли гулять.

definition: to disagree with a plan and try to stop it
sentence: Most of the neighbours {oppose} the new car park.
translation: Большинство соседей против новой парковки.

definition: relating to the place where you were born
sentence: Spanish is her {native} language, not English.

translation: Он провёл два года в тюрьме за кражу.

definition: a reason you give to explain why you did something wrong
sentence: Being tired is no {excuse} for being rude.
translation: Усталость — не оправдание для грубости.

definition: the room where food is cooked
sentence: Mom is making dinner in the {kitchen}.
translation: Мама готовит ужин на кухне.

definition: the ability to see, or something that you see
sentence: The old man is slowly losing his {sight}.
translation: Старик постепенно теряет зрение.

definition: to stop working because you have reached a certain age
sentence: My father will {retire} at sixty-five.
translation: Мой отец выйдет на пенсию в шестьдесят пять.

definition: a flat piece of wood or glass, or a group of people who judge
sentence: The {panel} of judges gave her the top score.
translation: Жюри поставило ей высший балл.

definition: the act of giving things to many people, or the way they are spread
sentence: The {distribution} of food to the villages took two days.
translation: Раздача еды по деревням заняла два дня.

definition: to get or buy something, or to learn a skill
sentence: The company plans to {acquire} two smaller firms.
translation: Компания планирует приобрести две фирмы поменьше.

definition: to talk in a friendly, informal way
sentence: We sat in the cafe and started to {chat} about work.
translation: Мы сидели в кафе и болтали о работе.

definition: making little or no noise, or calm and peaceful
sentence: Please be {quiet}; the baby is sleeping.
translation: Пожалуйста, тише: ребёнок спит.

definition: a hollow metal object that makes a ringing sound when hit
sentence: The church {bell} rings every Sunday morning.
translation: Церковный колокол звонит каждое воскресное утро.

definition: the act of printing a book or article, or the printed thing itself
sentence: The {publication} of her first novel changed her life.
translation: Публикация первого романа изменила её жизнь.

definition: made of gold or having the bright yellow color of gold
sentence: Her {golden} hair shone in the sun.
translation: Её золотистые волосы сияли на солнце.

definition: relating to science, or using careful methods like science
sentence: There is no {scientific} proof that the medicine works.
translation: Нет научных доказательств, что лекарство работает.

definition: the possibility that something bad or harmful will happen
sentence: The sign warns of {danger} on the thin ice.
translation: Знак предупреждает об опасности на тонком льду.

definition: a government department, or the work of a priest
sentence: She works at the {ministry} of education.
translation: Она работает в министерстве образования.

definition: a feeling that something is true or exists, or a religious idea
sentence: His {belief} in God helped him through hard times.
translation: Вера в Бога помогла ему пережить трудные времена.

definition: small and not very important or serious
sentence: He had a {minor} injury and played the next day.
translation: У него была лёгкая травма, и он играл на следующий день.

definition: to make someone feel unhappy or worried
sentence: I did not mean to {upset} you with my comment.
translation: Я не хотел расстроить тебя своим замечанием.

definition: to be different in different situations, or to change something
sentence: Prices {vary} from one shop to another.
translation: Цены различаются от магазина к магазину.

definition: a small round object on clothes that holds them closed, or a switch you press
sentence: A {button} fell off my coat this morning.
translation: Сегодня утром у пальто оторвалась пуговица.

definition: a narrow road, or one of the lines of a wide road for cars
sentence: Move into the left {lane} before the turn.
translation: Перестройся в левую полосу перед поворотом.

definition: a substance in meat, eggs and beans that the body needs to grow
sentence: Eggs are a cheap source of {protein}.
translation: Яйца — дешёвый источник белка.

definition: the act of choosing, or a group of things you can choose from
sentence: The shop has a wide {selection} of cheeses.
translation: В магазине широкий выбор сыров.

definition: the situation or words around something that help explain its meaning
sentence: You cannot understand the joke without the {context}.
translation: Без контекста шутку не понять.

definition: the point where something begins, or where a person comes from
sentence: Nobody knows the {origin} of the old song.
translation: Никто не знает происхождения старой песни.

definition: something given, especially to a god, or a product offered for sale
sentence: The villagers left an {offering} of fruit at the temple door.
translation: Жители деревни оставили подношение из фруктов у дверей храма.

definition: a drawing that shows information as lines, bars or a table
sentence: The {chart} shows sales for each month.
translation: График показывает продажи за каждый месяц.

definition: a spirit from God, often shown with wings, or a very kind person
sentence: The painting shows an {angel} with white wings.
translation: На картине изображён ангел с белыми крыльями.

definition: to move through water using your arms and legs
sentence: The children learned to {swim} in the lake.
translation: Дети научились плавать в озере.

definition: feeling strong displeasure because of something bad
sentence: She was {angry} when the bus left without her.
translation: Она разозлилась, когда автобус уехал без неё.

definition: words that are believed to have magic power, or a short period of something
sentence: The witch put a {spell} on the prince.
translation: Ведьма наложила заклятие на принца.

definition: to pay someone to work for you, or to use something
sentence: The restaurant plans to {employ} three new cooks.
translation: Ресторан планирует нанять трёх новых поваров.

definition: to offer to do something without being asked or paid
sentence: Many students {volunteer} at the animal shelter.
translation: Многие студенты работают волонтёрами в приюте для животных.

definition: a competition in which people try to win a prize
sentence: She won first prize in the singing {contest}.
translation: Она взяла первый приз на конкурсе пения.

definition: a friend, or the partner of an animal that it has young with
sentence: He went to the pub with his {mate} from work.
translation: Он пошёл в паб с приятелем с работы.

definition: to become well again after an illness, or to get something back
sentence: It took him a month to {recover} from the operation.
translation: Ему понадобился месяц, чтобы восстановиться после операции.

definition: judged by comparing with something else, not absolute
sentence: After the war, the town enjoyed {relative} peace.
translation: После войны город жил в относительном мире.

definition: to try to win against others in a game, race or business
sentence: Ten teams will {compete} for the cup this year.
translation: В этом году за кубок будут бороться десять команд.

definition: a measure of how good or popular something is
sentence: The hotel has a five-star {rating} on the website.
translation: У отеля пятизвёздочный рейтинг на сайте.

definition: something given for doing good work or helping someone
sentence: The police offered a {reward} for information about the thief.
translation: Полиция объявила награду за сведения о воре.

definition: the part of the body that joins the head to the shoulders
sentence: She wore a gold chain around her {neck}.
translation: На шее у неё была золотая цепочка.

definition: a large building with seats around a field for sports and concerts
sentence: The new {stadium} holds sixty thousand people.
translation: Новый стадион вмещает шестьдесят тысяч человек.

definition: medical treatment in which a doctor cuts open the body to repair it
sentence: She needs {surgery} on her knee after the fall.
translation: После падения ей нужна операция на колене.

definition: a person traveling in a car, bus, train or plane but not driving it
sentence: Every {passenger} must wear a seat belt.
translation: Каждый пассажир должен пристегнуть ремень.

definition: the pointed top of a mountain, or the highest point of something
sentence: Snow covers the {peak} all year round.
translation: Снег лежит на вершине круглый год.

definition: making you feel relaxed, or feeling relaxed and without pain
sentence: This chair is very {comfortable} for reading.
translation: Это кресло очень удобно для чтения.

definition: relating to feelings, or showing strong feelings
sentence: It was an {emotional} moment when they met again.
translation: Их новая встреча была трогательным моментом.

definition: in or to every place
sentence: I looked {everywhere} but could not find my keys.
translation: Я искал везде, но так и не нашёл ключи.

definition: inside something, or within a country or organization
sentence: The company sent an {internal} email to all staff.
translation: Компания разослала внутреннее письмо всем сотрудникам.

definition: quite, when compared with other things
sentence: The exam was {relatively} easy this year.
translation: В этом году экзамен был сравнительно лёгким.

definition: to make someone unable to think clearly, or to mix up two things
sentence: Too many signs only {confuse} the drivers.
translation: Слишком много знаков только сбивают водителей с толку.

definition: a large, ugly and scary animal or person in stories
sentence: The child dreamed of a {monster} under the bed.
translation: Ребёнку приснилось чудовище под кроватью.

definition: the food eaten at one time, such as breakfast or dinner
sentence: We had a big {meal} at my grandmother's house.
translation: Мы плотно поели в доме бабушки.

definition: the flesh of animals that people eat
sentence: She does not eat {meat} or fish.
translation: Она не ест мясо и рыбу.

definition: a picture made with a camera
sentence: This {photograph} of my parents was taken in 1980.
translation: Эта фотография моих родителей сделана в 1980 году.

definition: wide, or including many different things
sentence: The river is very {broad} near the sea.
translation: Ближе к морю река очень широкая.

definition: the part of a machine that makes it move or work
sentence: The {motor} of the washing machine stopped working.
translation: Мотор стиральной машины перестал работать.

definition: to show clearly how something works or that something is true
sentence: Let me {demonstrate} how the new phone works.
translation: Позвольте мне показать, как работает новый телефон.

definition: to make someone come closer or become interested
sentence: Bright flowers {attract} bees and butterflies.
translation: Яркие цветы привлекают пчёл и бабочек.

definition: unusual or surprising, or not known to you before
sentence: A {strange} noise came from the kitchen.
translation: Из кухни донёсся странный звук.

definition: a time when things are very bad or dangerous
sentence: We had a small {crisis} when the oven stopped working.
translation: У нас случился небольшой кризис, когда сломалась духовка.

definition: a competition to find the best player or team in a sport
sentence: Our team won the national {championship} last year.
translation: В прошлом году наша команда выиграла национальный чемпионат.

definition: a plan or idea that is suggested, or an offer of marriage
sentence: The council rejected the {proposal} for a new road.
translation: Совет отклонил предложение о строительстве новой дороги.

definition: not normal, not what you expect
sentence: It's {odd} that he hasn't called all week.
translation: Странно, что он не звонил всю неделю.

definition: not mixed with anything else, or clean and simple
sentence: This ring is made of {pure} gold.
translation: Это кольцо сделано из чистого золота.

definition: a country ruled by a king or queen
sentence: The old {kingdom} was divided between two brothers.
translation: Старое королевство было разделено между двумя братьями.

definition: to use rude words, or to make a serious promise
sentence: Do not {swear} in front of the children.
translation: Не ругайся при детях.

definition: a scientific test done to learn something or prove an idea
sentence: The students did an {experiment} with magnets.
translation: Ученики провели опыт с магнитами.

definition: a device for catching animals, or a trick for catching a person
sentence: The farmer set a {trap} for the fox.
translation: Фермер поставил ловушку на лису.

definition: a round sweet fruit with a thick skin, or its color
sentence: She peeled an {orange} and shared it with me.
translation: Она очистила апельсин и поделилась со мной.

definition: to put a machine or program in place so it is ready to use
sentence: You need to {install} the app before you can use it.
translation: Нужно установить приложение, прежде чем им пользоваться.

definition: something that tells you that danger or trouble may come
sentence: The doctor gave him a {warning} about his heart.
translation: Врач предупредил его насчёт сердца.

definition: a circle of gold and jewels that a king or queen wears
sentence: The queen wore a {crown} with red stones.
translation: На королеве была корона с красными камнями.

definition: a performance of music for an audience
sentence: We went to a rock {concert} on Saturday.
translation: В субботу мы ходили на рок-концерт.

definition: kind and pleasant to others, or not hurting people or nature
sentence: The people in the village were very {friendly}.
translation: Люди в деревне были очень приветливыми.

definition: the feeling that you can do something well, or trust in someone
sentence: Practice gave her the {confidence} to speak in public.
translation: Практика придала ей уверенности выступать на публике.

definition: many; a large number of
sentence: She has visited Italy on {numerous} occasions.
translation: Она бывала в Италии много раз.

definition: for one particular purpose or person, or in a clear exact way
sentence: The course is designed {specifically} for beginners.
translation: Курс разработан специально для начинающих.

definition: relating to a town or city
sentence: Noise is a big problem in {urban} areas.
translation: Шум — большая проблема в городских районах.

definition: an explanation of what a word means
sentence: Look up the {definition} of the word in the dictionary.
translation: Посмотри определение слова в словаре.

definition: to give a document or form to a person in authority
sentence: I {submitted} my application ten minutes before the deadline.
translation: Я подал заявку за десять минут до дедлайна.

definition: to decide that a planned event will not happen
sentence: They had to {cancel} the match because of rain.
translation: Им пришлось отменить матч из-за дождя.

definition: a device that stores electric power for a phone, car or toy
sentence: My phone {battery} is almost dead.
translation: Батарея телефона почти разрядилась.

definition: completely necessary, so important you cannot do without it
sentence: Good shoes are {essential} for a long walk.
translation: Хорошая обувь необходима для долгой прогулки.

definition: a white or gray mass floating in the sky, made of tiny drops of water
sentence: A dark {cloud} hid the sun before the storm.
translation: Перед грозой тёмная туча закрыла солнце.

definition: a building where goods are made with machines
sentence: My uncle works in a car {factory}.
translation: Мой дядя работает на автомобильном заводе.

definition: the act of killing yourself on purpose
sentence: The charity helps people who are thinking about {suicide}.
translation: Эта организация помогает людям, думающим о самоубийстве.

definition: a white substance used to give food flavor, found in sea water
sentence: Add a pinch of {salt} to the soup.
translation: Добавь в суп щепотку соли.

definition: the person who is elected to lead a town or city
sentence: The {mayor} opened the new bridge yesterday.
translation: Вчера мэр открыл новый мост.

definition: a vehicle with two wheels that you ride by pushing pedals, or with a motor
sentence: I ride my {bike} to school every day.
translation: Я каждый день езжу в школу на велосипеде.

definition: a belief or way of doing things that has continued for a long time
sentence: It is a family {tradition} to eat together on Sundays.
translation: По семейной традиции мы обедаем вместе по воскресеньям.

definition: to travel through a new place to learn about it, or to examine an idea
sentence: We spent the day trying to {explore} the old town.
translation: Мы провели день, исследуя старый город.

definition: a piece of clothing worn on the head
sentence: Wear a {hat} to protect your head from the sun.
translation: Надень шляпу, чтобы защитить голову от солнца.

definition: a way of thinking about something from a particular position
sentence: Travelling gave me a new {perspective} on my own country.
translation: Путешествия дали мне новый взгляд на собственную страну.

definition: a firm decision to do something, or an official decision by a group
sentence: My New Year's {resolution} is to read more books.
translation: Моё новогоднее решение — читать больше книг.

definition: a tall narrow building, or a tall part of a building
sentence: From the top of the {tower} you can see the whole city.
translation: С вершины башни виден весь город.

definition: to throw a ball in baseball, or to try to sell an idea
sentence: He will {pitch} for the home team tonight.
translation: Сегодня он будет подавать за домашнюю команду.

definition: the number 0, or nothing at all
sentence: The temperature dropped below {zero} last night.
translation: Прошлой ночью температура опустилась ниже нуля.

definition: the look on your face, or a word or phrase, or showing a feeling
sentence: She had a puzzled {expression} on her face.
translation: На её лице было озадаченное выражение.

definition: a group of people who meet to make decisions, or putting parts together
sentence: The national {assembly} voted on the new law.
translation: Национальное собрание проголосовало за новый закон.

definition: something you give or do to help make something successful
sentence: Her {contribution} to the project was huge.
translation: Её вклад в проект был огромным.

definition: to watch something carefully, or to notice something
sentence: Scientists {observe} the birds from a small hut.
translation: Учёные наблюдают за птицами из маленькой хижины.

definition: an alphabetical list at the end of a book, or a number showing a change
sentence: Look in the {index} to find the page about Rome.
translation: Найди в указателе страницу про Рим.

definition: a sheet of material lying over or under another
sentence: A thick {layer} of snow covered the road.
translation: Дорогу покрыл толстый слой снега.

definition: a plane, helicopter or other machine that flies
sentence: The {aircraft} landed safely despite the storm.
translation: Воздушное судно благополучно приземлилось, несмотря на бурю.

definition: close to a number but not exactly
sentence: The journey takes {approximately} two hours.
translation: Поездка занимает примерно два часа.

definition: relating to a large company or group of companies
sentence: She left her {corporate} job to open a bakery.
translation: Она ушла из корпорации, чтобы открыть пекарню.

definition: correctly, or in a way that is right and suitable
sentence: Make sure the door is {properly} locked.
translation: Убедись, что дверь как следует заперта.

definition: a building where grain is made into flour, or a factory for cloth or paper
sentence: The old {mill} by the river is now a museum.
translation: Старая мельница у реки теперь музей.

definition: a person who writes news for newspapers, television or websites
sentence: The {journalist} asked the minister a hard question.
translation: Журналист задал министру трудный вопрос.

definition: a fact or condition that affects a situation
sentence: Under no {circumstance} should you open that door.
translation: Ни при каких обстоятельствах не открывай ту дверь.

definition: the act of bringing goods or letters to a place
sentence: The shop offers free {delivery} on large orders.
translation: Магазин предлагает бесплатную доставку крупных заказов.

definition: a survey of what people think, or the voting in an election
sentence: A recent {poll} shows the president losing support.
translation: Недавний опрос показывает, что президент теряет поддержку.

definition: a part of something, or the amount of food served to one person
sentence: The restaurant serves a huge {portion} of pasta.
translation: В ресторане подают огромную порцию пасты.

definition: the qualities that make a person different from others
sentence: He has a warm and friendly {personality}.
translation: У него тёплый и дружелюбный характер.

definition: the thick fatty part of milk, or a soft substance you put on skin
sentence: I like fresh strawberries with cold {cream}.
translation: Я люблю свежую клубнику с холодными сливками.

definition: the place where God lives and good people go after death
sentence: Grandma believed she would see him again in {heaven}.
translation: Бабушка верила, что снова увидит его на небесах.

definition: to put a plan or decision into action
sentence: The school will {implement} the new timetable in September.
translation: Школа введёт новое расписание в сентябре.

definition: a sea animal with smooth fur that eats fish, or an official mark
sentence: A {seal} lay on the rock in the sun.
translation: Тюлень лежал на камне на солнце.

definition: a competition with many games in which the winner goes on to the next round
sentence: Sixteen teams entered the chess {tournament}.
translation: В шахматном турнире участвовали шестнадцать команд.

definition: relating to schools, colleges and study, rather than practical skills
sentence: Her {academic} results were the best in the year.
translation: Её успеваемость была лучшей в выпуске.

definition: a small piece of paper or plastic attached to something with information on it
sentence: The price {tag} says forty dollars.
translation: На ценнике написано сорок долларов.

definition: completely different, or across from something
sentence: They live on the {opposite} side of the street.
translation: Они живут на противоположной стороне улицы.

definition: the food a person usually eats, or a plan of eating less to lose weight
sentence: A healthy {diet} includes fresh fruit and vegetables.
translation: Здоровый рацион включает свежие фрукты и овощи.

definition: a long flat surface in a shop or kitchen where things are served or prepared
sentence: Leave the keys on the kitchen {counter}.
translation: Оставь ключи на кухонной стойке.

definition: all the people who live together in one house
sentence: The average {household} spends a lot on food.
translation: Средняя семья тратит на еду немало.

definition: an exciting and sometimes dangerous experience or journey
sentence: Climbing the mountain was a real {adventure}.
translation: Восхождение на гору было настоящим приключением.

definition: a country or person that helps and supports another
sentence: Britain was an {ally} of France in the war.
translation: Британия была союзником Франции в войне.

definition: containing nothing or nobody
sentence: The bottle was {empty}, so I threw it away.
translation: Бутылка была пустая, и я её выбросил.

definition: to save someone or something from danger
sentence: Firefighters managed to {rescue} the cat from the roof.
translation: Пожарным удалось спасти кошку с крыши.

definition: fitting closely, or held firmly, or strict
sentence: These shoes are too {tight} for me.
translation: Эти туфли мне слишком тесны.

definition: to say that you are unhappy about something
sentence: Customers often {complain} about the slow service.
translation: Клиенты часто жалуются на медленное обслуживание.

definition: a piece of music played or sung by one person
sentence: The guitar {solo} in that song is famous.
translation: Гитарное соло в этой песне знаменито.

definition: very small
sentence: A {tiny} bird sat on the fence.
translation: Крошечная птичка сидела на заборе.

definition: a small bag sewn into clothes for keeping things in
sentence: He put the coins in his {pocket}.
translation: Он положил монеты в карман.

definition: very great in degree, or very far from normal
sentence: The desert has {extreme} heat during the day.
translation: Днём в пустыне стоит невыносимая жара.

definition: to refuse to accept an offer, idea or person
sentence: They {rejected} my offer without even reading it.
translation: Они отклонили моё предложение, даже не прочитав.

definition: in the most important ways, without the details
sentence: The two plans are {basically} the same.
translation: Эти два плана в основном одинаковы.

definition: in addition to what has been said
sentence: I am tired; {besides}, it is too late to go out.
translation: Я устал, к тому же уже слишком поздно идти гулять.

definition: the reporting of an event in the news, or the area a service reaches
sentence: The election got a lot of {coverage} on television.
translation: Выборы широко освещались по телевидению.

definition: not true or correct, or not real
sentence: The report gave a {false} picture of the company.
translation: Отчёт дал ложную картину дел в компании.

definition: money given by a government or organization for a purpose
sentence: The theater lost its public {funding} last year.
translation: В прошлом году театр лишился государственного финансирования.

definition: very hard to believe, or extremely good
sentence: The view from the top was {incredible}.
translation: Вид с вершины был невероятный.

definition: easy to see or understand, clear to anyone
sentence: It's {obvious} that she likes you.
translation: Очевидно же, что ты ей нравишься.

definition: at a slow speed; not quickly
sentence: Please speak {slowly} so I can understand.
translation: Пожалуйста, говори медленно, чтобы я понял.

definition: every time that, or at any time that
sentence: Call me {whenever} you need help.
translation: Звони мне, когда бы тебе ни понадобилась помощь.

definition: a number that shows a fact about a group of people or things
sentence: One {statistic} shows that most people sleep too little.
translation: Одна статистика показывает, что большинство людей спит слишком мало.

definition: the act of moving, or a formal suggestion at a meeting
sentence: The {motion} of the boat made her feel sick.
translation: От качки лодки её затошнило.

definition: a way of behaving that is traditional in a place or group
sentence: It is the {custom} to take off your shoes indoors.
translation: Здесь принято снимать обувь в помещении.

definition: a box or parcel with things inside, or a set of things sold together
sentence: The {package} arrived two days after I ordered it.
translation: Посылка пришла через два дня после заказа.

definition: a device that sprays water for washing your body, or a short fall of rain
sentence: I take a quick {shower} every morning.
translation: Каждое утро я быстро принимаю душ.

definition: the way something is done, or the way a person behaves
sentence: She explained the problem in a calm {manner}.
translation: Она спокойно объяснила проблему.

definition: to give all your time and energy to one thing
sentence: She {dedicated} her whole weekend to fixing the bike.
translation: Она посвятила все выходные ремонту велосипеда.

definition: relating to the sea or to animals and plants living in it
sentence: Pollution is a threat to {marine} life.
translation: Загрязнение — угроза морской жизни.

definition: a particular time when something happens, or a special event
sentence: We only wear these clothes on a special {occasion}.
translation: Мы надеваем эту одежду только по особому случаю.

definition: to leave a job or stop doing something
sentence: He decided to {quit} smoking for good.
translation: Он решил бросить курить навсегда.

definition: making a lot of noise
sentence: The music was so {loud} that I could not talk.
translation: Музыка была такой громкой, что я не мог говорить.

definition: to say that someone has done something wrong or illegal
sentence: They {accuse} him of stealing the money.
translation: Они обвиняют его в краже денег.

definition: a thick wire that carries power or signals, or a strong rope
sentence: Plug the {cable} into the back of the computer.
translation: Подключи кабель к задней панели компьютера.

definition: to make something longer or wider, or to reach out your arms and legs
sentence: Always {stretch} your muscles before you run.
translation: Всегда разминай мышцы перед бегом.

definition: to make someone sad because something is not as good as they hoped
sentence: I am sorry to {disappoint} you, but the trip is off.
translation: Жаль тебя огорчать, но поездка отменяется.

definition: the fact of being male or female
sentence: The form asks for your name, age and {gender}.
translation: В анкете спрашивают имя, возраст и пол.

definition: a country without a king, whose leader is elected by the people
sentence: France became a {republic} after the revolution.
translation: После революции Франция стала республикой.

definition: to move quickly up and down or from side to side
sentence: You should {shake} the bottle before opening it.
translation: Нужно встряхнуть бутылку перед тем, как открыть.

definition: to come out from a place where you could not be seen
sentence: She {emerged} from the shop with four heavy bags.
translation: Она вышла из магазина с четырьмя тяжёлыми пакетами.

definition: to remember something, or to ask for a product to be returned
sentence: I cannot {recall} where I left my glasses.
translation: Не могу вспомнить, где оставил очки.

definition: to have enough money or time to do or buy something
sentence: We cannot {afford} a holiday abroad this year.
translation: В этом году мы не можем позволить себе отпуск за границей.

definition: a man or boy that someone is having a romantic relationship with
sentence: Her {boyfriend} bought her flowers for her birthday.
translation: Её парень подарил ей цветы на день рождения.

definition: a person who chooses a leader in an election by marking a paper
sentence: Every {voter} received a letter about the election.
translation: Каждый избиратель получил письмо о выборах.

definition: books, poems and plays that are valued as art
sentence: She teaches English {literature} at the university.
translation: Она преподаёт английскую литературу в университете.

definition: used when the people who do the action also receive it
sentence: We enjoyed {ourselves} at the party.
translation: Мы хорошо повеселились на вечеринке.

definition: usually; in most cases
sentence: Lessons {typically} last about forty minutes.
translation: Уроки обычно длятся около сорока минут.

definition: used to say that something is sad or disappointing
sentence: {Unfortunately}, the last train has already left.
translation: К сожалению, последний поезд уже ушёл.

definition: happening or done most of the time
sentence: We met at the {usual} place after work.
translation: Мы встретились после работы в обычном месте.

definition: to allow someone to do something
sentence: The rules do not {permit} smoking in the building.
translation: Правила не разрешают курить в здании.

definition: the first meal of the day, eaten in the morning
sentence: I had eggs and toast for {breakfast}.
translation: На завтрак я ел яйца с тостами.

definition: higher than average, or of a particular height
sentence: My brother is very {tall} for his age.
translation: Мой брат очень высокий для своего возраста.

definition: unable to think or speak clearly because of drinking too much alcohol
sentence: He was too {drunk} to drive home.
translation: Он был слишком пьян, чтобы вести машину домой.

definition: the top covering of a building or a car
sentence: Rain was coming in through a hole in the {roof}.
translation: Дождь протекал через дыру в крыше.

definition: the distance from the top down to the bottom of something
sentence: The lake has a {depth} of thirty meters.
translation: Глубина озера — тридцать метров.

definition: to annoy or worry someone, or to make an effort to do something
sentence: Does the noise from the street {bother} you?
translation: Тебя беспокоит шум с улицы?

definition: a fast turning movement, or a short ride in a car
sentence: Give the wheel a {spin} and see where it stops.
translation: Крутани колесо и посмотри, где оно остановится.

definition: to meet someone or face a problem unexpectedly
sentence: You may {encounter} some difficulties on the road.
translation: В дороге вы можете столкнуться с некоторыми трудностями.

definition: drinks such as beer and wine that can make you drunk
sentence: The doctor told him to avoid {alcohol} completely.
translation: Врач велел ему полностью отказаться от алкоголя.

definition: a path through the countryside, or marks left by something that has passed
sentence: We followed the {trail} up through the forest.
translation: Мы пошли по тропе вверх через лес.

definition: a part of the body that pulls bones to make you move
sentence: I hurt a {muscle} in my back lifting the box.
translation: Я потянул мышцу спины, поднимая коробку.

definition: an animal kept at home for pleasure
sentence: Our family {pet} is a small gray rabbit.
translation: Наш домашний питомец — маленький серый кролик.

definition: a result of an action, often a bad one
sentence: Missing the bus had one {consequence}: I missed the interview.
translation: У опоздания на автобус было одно последствие: я пропустил собеседование.

definition: a person who comes to see a place or person
sentence: The museum gets a million visitors a year, and each {visitor} pays five euros.
translation: Музей принимает миллион посетителей в год, и каждый посетитель платит пять евро.

definition: a sound, especially one that is loud or unpleasant
sentence: The {noise} from the road kept me awake.
translation: Шум с дороги не давал мне уснуть.

definition: funny, or relating to comedy
sentence: The film has several {comic} scenes.
translation: В фильме есть несколько комических сцен.

definition: a person who owns or works on a farm
sentence: The {farmer} gets up at five to milk the cows.
translation: Фермер встаёт в пять, чтобы подоить коров.

definition: a room used for a special purpose, or one part of a parliament
sentence: The council meets in the main {chamber} of the town hall.
translation: Совет собирается в главном зале ратуши.

definition: a sweet food made from flour, eggs, sugar and butter, baked in an oven
sentence: She baked a chocolate {cake} for the party.
translation: Она испекла шоколадный торт к празднику.

definition: to speak to God to give thanks or ask for help
sentence: They {pray} together before every meal.
translation: Они молятся вместе перед каждой едой.

definition: not worried or excited, or without wind or big waves
sentence: Stay {calm} and wait for the doctor.
translation: Сохраняй спокойствие и жди врача.

definition: to post a short message on the social network X, formerly Twitter
sentence: The minister likes to {tweet} about every meeting he attends.
translation: Министр любит писать в соцсети о каждой встрече, которую посещает.

definition: the largest amount or number possible or allowed
sentence: The lift carries a {maximum} of eight people.
translation: Лифт вмещает максимум восемь человек.

definition: able to do something, or skilled and able to do things well
sentence: She is {capable} of running the whole office alone.
translation: Она способна одна управлять всем офисом.

definition: well known to you, or knowing something well
sentence: Her face looked {familiar}, but I could not remember her name.
translation: Её лицо показалось знакомым, но я не мог вспомнить имя.

definition: having done something wrong, or feeling bad because of it
sentence: The jury found him {guilty} of theft.
translation: Присяжные признали его виновным в краже.

definition: mostly; to a great degree
sentence: The success of the show was {largely} due to its music.
translation: Успех шоу был во многом обязан его музыке.

definition: completely, or in a way that could not be better
sentence: The new dress fits her {perfectly}, as if made for her.
translation: Новое платье сидит на ней идеально, словно сшито для неё.

definition: connected with what is being discussed or done
sentence: Please bring any {relevant} documents to the meeting.
translation: Пожалуйста, принесите на встречу все относящиеся к делу документы.

definition: not able to do something
sentence: She was {unable} to come because of her work.
translation: Она не смогла прийти из-за работы.

definition: a feeling of happiness or enjoyment
sentence: Reading in the garden is her greatest {pleasure}.
translation: Чтение в саду — её главное удовольствие.

definition: a person who is second in command and acts when the boss is away
sentence: The {deputy} ran the office while the manager was abroad.
translation: Заместитель руководил офисом, пока начальник был за границей.

definition: a person who agrees with and helps a team, party or idea
sentence: Every {supporter} of the club got a free scarf.
translation: Каждый болельщик клуба получил бесплатный шарф.
